# Color Theme Audit

The current VeganAdda palette uses earth tones, greens, and clays:
`--canvas: #fcf9f3` (warm cream)
`--surface: #fff`
`--soft: #f6f3ed`
`--line: #ebe8e2`
`--control: #7e877c`
`--green: #012d1d` (very dark forest green, primary text/action)
`--green-hover: #28573e`
`--focus: #bb6748`
`--forest: #1b4332`
`--clay: #9d4225` (terracotta)
`--mint: #c1ecd4`
`--text: #1c1c18`
`--muted: #58615a`
`--error: #991b1b`

This palette is very grounded and earthy. While nice, the user has asked for fresh, modern, and clean themes while maintaining usability (contrast).

## Proposal 1: "Fresh Berry & Teal" (Modern, vibrant but clean)
Replacing the heavy greens and clays with a modern, fresh palette that still feels natural but more energetic.

`--canvas: #f8f9fa` (cool off-white)
`--surface: #ffffff`
`--soft: #f1f3f5`
`--line: #e9ecef`
`--control: #adb5bd`
`--green: #0077b6` (vibrant ocean blue as primary action)
`--green-hover: #023e8a`
`--focus: #d90429`
`--forest: #03045e`
`--clay: #e5383b` (berry red accent)
`--mint: #caf0f8`
`--text: #212529`
`--muted: #6c757d`
`--error: #c1121f`

## Proposal 2: "Modern Sage & Lavender" (Soft, fresh, elegant)
A more muted, elegant modern theme that feels calming and clean.

`--canvas: #fbfbfa`
`--surface: #ffffff`
`--soft: #f4f4f2`
`--line: #e2e2df`
`--control: #a3a39e`
`--green: #5a189a` (deep purple primary)
`--green-hover: #3c096c`
`--focus: #ff9e00`
`--forest: #240046`
`--clay: #7b2cbf`
`--mint: #e0aaff`
`--text: #2b2b2a`
`--muted: #737370`
`--error: #d90429`
